# Third-party notices

Generated from Cargo.lock. Includes conditional/build dependencies.

License texts are reproduced below where supplied in the crate root. SQLite is public domain.


## Toolchain runtimes

Rust standard library: MIT/Apache-2.0. Linux static builds include musl libc. LLVM compiler-runtime portions use Apache-2.0 with LLVM exceptions. Original license texts follow.
